environments.name: Adventure
environments.summary: You must find the enchanted chalice and return it to the golden castle. You can pick up various objects (keys, a sword,a bridge, or a magnet) and have to fight or outmanoeuvre dragons.

environments.name: Airraid
environments.summary: Airraid is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Alien
environments.summary: You are stuck in a maze-like spaceship with three aliens. You goal is to destroy their eggs that are scattered all over the ship while simultaneously avoiding the aliens (they are trying to kill you). You have a flamethrower that can help you turn them away in tricky situations. Moreover, you can occasionally collect a power-up (pulsar) that gives you the temporary ability to kill aliens.

environments.name: Amidar
environments.summary: This game is similar to Pac-Man, you are trying to visit all places on a 2-dimensional grid while simultaneously avoiding your enemies. You can turn the tables at one point in the game with your enemies turn into chickens and you can catch them.

environments.name: Assault
environments.summary: You control a vehicle that can move sideways. A big mother ship circles overhead and continually deploys smaller drones. You must destroy these enemies and dodge their attacks.

environments.name: Asterix
environments.summary: You are Asterix and can move horizontally (continuously) and vertically (discretely). Objects move horizontally across the screen including lyres and other (more useful) objects. Your goal is to guideAsterix in such a way as to avoid lyres and collect as many other objects as possible. You score points by collecting objects and lose a life whenever you collect a lyre. You have three lives available at the beginning. If you score sufficiently many points, you will be awarded additional points.

environments.name: Asteroids
environments.summary: You control a spaceship in an asteroid field and must break up asteroids by shooting them. Once all asteroids are destroyed, you enter a new level and new asteroids will appear. You will occasionally be attacked by a flying saucer.

environments.name: Atlantis
environments.summary: Your job is to defend the submerged city of Atlantis. Your enemies slowly descend towards the city and you must destroy them before they reach striking distance. To this end, you control three defense posts. You lose if your enemies manage to destroy all seven of Atlantis’ installations. You may rebuild installations after you have fought of a wave of enemies and scored a sufficient number of points.

environments.name: Atlantis2
environments.summary: Atlantis2 is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Backgammon
environments.summary: Backgammon is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Bank Heist
environments.summary: You are a bank robber and (naturally) want to rob as many banks as possible. You control your getaway car and must navigate maze-like cities. The police chases you and will appear whenever you rob a bank. You may destroy police cars by dropping sticks of dynamite. You can fill up your gas tank by entering a new city. At the beginning of the game you have four lives. Lives are lost if you run out of gas, are caught by the police,or run over the dynamite you have previously dropped.

environments.name: Basic Math
environments.summary: Basic Math is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Battle Zone
environments.summary: You control a tank and must destroy enemy vehicles. This game is played in a first-person perspective and creates a 3D illusion. A radar screen shows enemies around you. You start with 5 lives and gain up to 2 extra lives if you reach a sufficient score.

environments.name: Beam Rider
environments.summary: You control a space-ship that travels forward at a constant speed. You can only steer it sideways between discrete positions. Your goal is to destroy enemy ships, avoid their attacks and dodge space debris.

environments.name: Berzerk
environments.summary: You are stuck in a maze with evil robots. You must destroy them and avoid touching the walls of the maze, as this will kill you. You may be awarded extra lives after scoring a sufficient number of points, depending on the game mode. You may also be chased by an undefeatable enemy, Evil Otto, that you must avoid. Evil Otto does not appear in the default mode.

environments.name: Blackjack
environments.summary: Blackjack is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Bowling
environments.summary: Your goal is to score as many points as possible in the game of Bowling. A game consists of 10 frames and you have two tries per frame. Knocking down all pins on the first try is called a “strike”. Knocking down all pins on the second roll is called a “spar”. Otherwise, the frame is called “open”.

environments.name: Boxing
environments.summary: You fight an opponent in a boxing ring. You score points for hitting the opponent. If you score 100 points, your opponent is knocked out.

environments.name: Breakout
environments.summary: You move a paddle and hit the ball in a brick wall at the top of the screen. Your goal is to destroy the brick wall. You can try to break through the wall and let the ball wreak havoc on the other side, all on its own! You have five lives.

environments.name: Carnival
environments.summary: Carnival is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Casino
environments.summary: Casino is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Centipede
environments.summary: You are an elf and must use your magic wands to fend off spiders, fleas and centipedes. Your goal is to protect mushrooms in an enchanted forest. If you are bitten by a spider, flea or centipede, you will be temporally paralyzed and you will lose a magic wand. The game ends once you have lost all wands. You may receive additional wands after scoring a sufficient number of points.

environments.name: Chopper Command
environments.summary: You control a helicopter and must protect truck convoys. To that end, you need to shoot down enemy aircraft. A mini-map is displayed at the bottom of the screen.

environments.name: Crazy Climber
environments.summary: You are a climber trying to reach the top of four buildings, while avoiding obstacles like closing windows and falling objects. When you receive damage (windows closing or objects) you will fall and lose one life; you have a total of 5 lives before the end games. At the top of each building, there’s a helicopter which you need to catch to get to the next building. The goal is to climb as fast as possible while receiving the least amount of damage.

environments.name: Crossbow
environments.summary: Crossbow is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Darkchambers
environments.summary: Darkchambers is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Defender
environments.summary: Aliens attack the earth. You control a spaceship and must defend humanity by destroying alien ships and rescuing humanoids. You have three lives and three smart bombs. You lose a live when you are shot down by an alien spaceship. Points are scored by destroying enemies and retrieving humans that are being abducted. You have an unlimited number of laser missiles.

environments.name: Demon Attack
environments.summary: You are facing waves of demons in the ice planet of Krybor. Points are accumulated by destroying demons. You begin with 3 reserve bunkers, and can increase its number (up to 6) by avoiding enemy attacks. Each attack wave you survive without any hits, grants you a new bunker. Every time an enemy hits you, a bunker is destroyed. When the last bunker falls, the next enemy hit will destroy you and the game ends.

environments.name: Donkey Kong
environments.summary: You play as Mario trying to save your girlfriend who has been kidnapped by Donkey Kong. Remove rivets and jump over fireballs, with a score that starts high and counts down throughout the game.

environments.name: Double Dunk
environments.summary: You are playing a 2v2 game of basketball. At the start of each possession, you select between a set of different plays and then execute them to either score or prevent your rivals from scoring.

environments.name: Earthworld
environments.summary: Earthworld is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Elevator Action
environments.summary: Elevator Action is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Enduro
environments.summary: You are a racer in the National Enduro, a long-distance endurance race. You must overtake a certain amount of cars each day to stay on the race. The first day you need to pass 200 cars, and 300 foreach following day. The game ends if you do not meet your overtake quota for the day.

environments.name: Entombed
environments.summary: Entombed is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Et
environments.summary: Et is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Fishing Derby
environments.summary: Your objective is to catch more sunfish than your opponent.

environments.name: Flag Capture
environments.summary: You are an explorer navigating from square to square, collecting clues, and looking for a flag.

environments.name: Freeway
environments.summary: Your objective is to guide your chicken across lane after lane of busy rush hour traffic. You receive a point for every chicken that makes it to the top of the screen after crossing all the lanes of traffic.

environments.name: Frogger
environments.summary: Frogger is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Frostbite
environments.summary: In Frostbite, the player controls “Frostbite Bailey” who hops back and forth across across an Arctic river, changing the color of the ice blocks from white to blue. Each time he does so, a block is added to his igloo.

environments.name: Galaxian
environments.summary: Galaxian is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Gopher
environments.summary: The player controls a shovel-wielding farmer who protects a crop of three carrots from a gopher.

environments.name: Gravitar
environments.summary: The player controls a small blue spacecraft. The game starts in a fictional solar system with several planets to explore. If the player moves his ship into a planet, he will be taken to a side-view landscape.

environments.name: Hangman
environments.summary: Hangman is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Haunted House
environments.summary: Explore a mansion haunted by the ghost of mean, old Samuel Graves. Your goal is to find three pieces of a magic urn and leave the mansion before losing your 9 lives.

environments.name: Hero
environments.summary: You need to rescue miners that are stuck in a mine shaft. You have access to various tools: a propeller backpack that allows you to fly wherever you want, sticks of dynamite that can be used to blast through walls, a laser beam to kill vermin, and a raft to float across stretches of lava. You have a limited amount of power. Once you run out, you lose a live.

environments.name: Human Cannonball
environments.summary: Human Cannonball is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Ice Hockey
environments.summary: Your goal is to score as many points as possible in a standard game of Ice Hockey over a 3-minute time period. The ball is usually called “the puck”. There are 32 shot angles ranging from the extreme left to the extreme right. The angles can only aim towards the opponent’s goal.Just as in real hockey, you can pass the puck by shooting it off the sides of the rink. This can be really key when you’re in position to score a goal.

environments.name: Jamesbond
environments.summary: Your mission is to control Mr. Bond’s specially designed multipurpose craft to complete a variety of missions. The craft moves forward with a right motion and slightly back with a left motion. An up or down motion causes the craft to jump or dive. You can also fire by either lobbing a bomb to the bottom of the screen or firing a fixed angle shot to the top of the screen.

environments.name: Journey Escape
environments.summary: Journey Escape is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Kaboom
environments.summary: Kaboom is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Kangaroo
environments.summary: The object of the game is to score as many points as you can while controlling Mother Kangaroo to rescue her precious baby. You start the game with three lives. During this rescue mission, Mother Kangaroo encounters many obstacles. You need to help her climb ladders, pick bonus fruit, and throw punches at monkeys.

environments.name: Keystone Kapers
environments.summary: Keystone Kapers is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: King Kong
environments.summary: King Kong is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Klax
environments.summary: Klax is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Koolaid
environments.summary: Koolaid is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Krull
environments.summary: Your mission is to find and enter the Beast’s Black Fortress, rescue Princess Lyssa, and destroy the Beast.The task is not an easy one, for the location of the Black Fortress changes with each sunrise on Krull.

environments.name: Kung Fu Master
environments.summary: You are a Kung-Fu Master fighting your way through the Evil Wizard’s temple. Your goal is to rescue Princess Victoria, defeating various enemies along the way.

environments.name: Laser Gates
environments.summary: Laser Gates is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Lost Luggage
environments.summary: Lost Luggage is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Mario Bros
environments.summary: Mario Bros is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Miniature Golf
environments.summary: Miniature Golf is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Montezuma Revenge
environments.summary: Your goal is to acquire Montezuma’s treasure by making your way through a maze of chambers within the emperor’s fortress. You must avoid deadly creatures while collecting valuables and tools which can help you escape with the treasure.

environments.name: Mr Do
environments.summary: Mr Do is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Ms Pacman
environments.summary: Your goal is to collect all of the pellets on the screen while avoiding the ghosts.

environments.name: Name This Game
environments.summary: Your goal is to defend the treasure that you have discovered. You must fight off a shark and an octopus while keeping an eye on your oxygen supply.

environments.name: Othello
environments.summary: Othello is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Pacman
environments.summary: A classic arcade game. Move Pac Man around a maze collecting food and avoiding ghosts- unless you eat a Power Pellet, then you can eat the ghosts too!

environments.name: Phoenix
environments.summary: Your goal is to reach and shoot the alien pilot. On your way there, you must eliminate waves of war birds while avoiding their bombs.

environments.name: Pitfall
environments.summary: You control Pitfall Harry and are tasked with collecting all the treasures in a jungle within 20 minutes. You have three lives. The game is over if you collect all the treasures or if you die or if the time runs out.

environments.name: Pitfall2
environments.summary: Pitfall2 is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Pong
environments.summary: You control the right paddle, you compete against the left paddle controlled by the computer. You each try to keep deflecting the ball away from your goal and into your opponent’s goal.

environments.name: Pooyan
environments.summary: Pooyan is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Private Eye
environments.summary: You control the French Private Eye Pierre Touche. Navigate the city streets, parks, secret passages, dead-ends and one-ways in search of the ringleader, Henri Le Fiend and his gang. You also need to find evidence and stolen goods that are scattered about. There are five cases, complete each case before its statute of limitations expires.

environments.name: Qbert
environments.summary: You are Q*bert. Your goal is to change the color of all the cubes on the pyramid to the pyramid’s ‘destination’ color. To do this, you must hop on each cube on the pyramid one at a time while avoiding nasty creatures that lurk there.

environments.name: Riverraid
environments.summary: You control a jet that flies over a river, you can move it sideways and fire missiles to destroy enemy objects. Each time an enemy object is destroyed you score points (i.e. rewards). You lose a jet when you run out of fuel, fly over a fuel depot when you begin to run low. You lose a jet even when it collides with the river bank or one of the enemy objects (except fuel depots). The game begins with a squadron of three jets in reserve and you’re given an additional jet (up to 9) for each 10,000 points you score.

environments.name: Road Runner
environments.summary: You control the Road Runner(TM) in a race; you can control the direction to run in and times to jumps. The goal is to outrun Wile E. Coyote(TM) while avoiding the hazards of the desert. The game begins with three lives. You lose a life when the coyote catches you, picks you up in a rocket, or shoots you with a cannon. You also lose a life when a truck hits you, you hit a land mine, you fall off a cliff,or you get hit by a falling rock. You score points (i.e. rewards) by eating seeds along the road, eating steel shot, and destroying the coyote.

environments.name: Robotank
environments.summary: You control your Robot Tanks to destroy enemies and avoid enemy fire. Game ends when all of your Robot Tanks are destroyed or all 12 enemy squadrons are destroyed. The game begins with one active Robot Tank and three reserves. Your Robot Tank may get lost when it is hit by enemy rocket fire - your video scrambles with static interference when this happens - or just become damaged - sensors report the damage by flashing on your control panel (look at V/C/R/T squares). You earn one bonus Robot Tank for every enemy squadron destroyed. The maximum number of bonus Robot Tanks allowed at any one time is 12.

environments.name: Seaquest
environments.summary: You control a sub able to move in all directions and fire torpedoes. The goal is to retrieve as many divers as you can, while dodging and blasting enemy subs and killer sharks; points will be awarded accordingly. The game begins with one sub and three waiting on the horizon. Each time you increase your score by 10,000 points, an extra sub will be delivered to yourbase. You can only have six reserve subs on the screen at one time. Your sub will explode if it collides with anything except your own divers. The sub has a limited amount of oxygen that decreases at a constant rate during the game. When the oxygen tank is almost empty, you need to surface and if you don’t do it in time, your sub will blow up and you’ll lose one diver. Each time you’re forced to surface, with less than six divers, you lose one diver as well.

environments.name: Sir Lancelot
environments.summary: Sir Lancelot is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Skiing
environments.summary: You control a skier who can move sideways. The goal is to run through all gates (between the poles) in the fastest time. You are penalized five seconds for each gate you miss. If you hit a gate or a tree, your skier will jump back up and keep going.

environments.name: Slot Machine
environments.summary: Slot Machine is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Solaris
environments.summary: You control a spaceship. Blast enemies before they can blast you. You can warp to different sectors. You have to defend Federation planets, and destroy Zylon forces. Keep track of your fuel, if you run out you lose a life. Warp to a Federation planet to refuel. The game ends if all your ships are destroyed or if you reach the Solaris planet.

environments.name: Space Invaders
environments.summary: Your objective is to destroy the space invaders by shooting your laser cannon at them before they reach the Earth. The game ends when all your lives are lost after taking enemy fire, or when they reach the earth.

environments.name: Space War
environments.summary: Space War is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Star Gunner
environments.summary: Stop the alien invasion by shooting down alien saucers and creatures while avoiding bombs.

environments.name: Superman
environments.summary: Superman is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Surround
environments.summary: Surround your opponent without running into anything yourself.

environments.name: Tennis
environments.summary: You control the orange player playing against a computer-controlled blue player. The game follows the rules of tennis. The first player to win at least 6 games with a margin of at least two games wins the match. If the score is tied at 6-6, the first player to go 2 games up wins the match.

environments.name: Tetris
environments.summary: Tetris is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Tic Tac Toe 3D
environments.summary: Tic Tac Toe 3D is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Time Pilot
environments.summary: You control an aircraft. Use it to destroy your enemies. As you progress in the game, you encounter enemies with technology that is increasingly from the future.

environments.name: Tron
environments.summary: Tron is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Turmoil
environments.summary: Turmoil is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Tutankham
environments.summary: Your goal is to rack up points by finding treasures in the mazes of the tomb while eliminating its guardians.

environments.name: Up N Down
environments.summary: Your goal is to steer your baja bugger to collect prizes and eliminate opponents.

environments.name: Venture
environments.summary: Your goal is to capture the treasure in every chamber of the dungeon while eliminating the monsters.

environments.name: Video Checkers
environments.summary: Video Checkers is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Video Chess
environments.summary: Video Chess is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Video Cube
environments.summary: Video Cube is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Video Pinball
environments.summary: Your goal is to keep the ball in play as long as possible and to score as many points as possible.

environments.name: Wizard Of Wor
environments.summary: Your goal is to beat the Wizard using your laser and radar scanner.

environments.name: Word Zapper
environments.summary: Word Zapper is an Atari 2600 environment supported in JAXAtari.

environments.name: Yars Revenge
environments.summary: The objective is to break a path through the shield and destroy the Qotile with a blast from the Zorlon Cannon.

environments.name: Zaxxon
environments.summary: Your goal is to stop the evil robot Zaxxon and its armies from enslaving the galaxy by piloting your fighter and shooting enemies.
